cards.art: monstrous repressed faces in flooded basement
cards.lore: It's not gone. It's just downstairs, lifting weights and waiting for you to fall asleep.
cards.name: THE UNCONSCIOUS (Das Unbewusste)
cards.power:
The Basement Flood
Play this card to resurrect a discarded Quest Card from the beginning of the game.

cards.art: men in trench coats in DMV waiting room
cards.lore: The waiting room of the mind. Ideas sit here until they are called or kicked out.
cards.name: THE PRECONSCIOUS (Vorbewusst)
cards.power:
Tip of the Tongue
The current player must finish their story without using the letter "I".

cards.art: bald censor with TOP SECRET stamp, redacting nude figure
cards.lore: He keeps at the door. He doesn't let the naked truth into the party.
cards.name: THE CENSOR (Die Zensur)
cards.power:
Redaction.
Interrupt a player. They must retell their last sentence using a euphemism.

cards.art: ecstatic dog with golden bone trophy
cards.lore: Freud says: Every dream is a wish. Even the one where you lose your teeth.
cards.name: THE WISH (Der Wunsch)
cards.power:
Immediate Gratification
Take the die and set it to [6]. Describe your perfect victory.

cards.art: cartoon faces crushed in giant trash compactor
cards.lore: Why have one anxiety when you can smash five faces into one monster? Efficient!
cards.name: CONDENSATION (Verdichtung)
cards.power:
Zip File.
Combine two Scene cards into one stack. They are now a single entity.

cards.art: dragon ignored, child screams at coat button
cards.lore: It's not about the Father. It's about the Father's coat button. Obsess over the button.
cards.name: DISPLACEMENT (Verschiebung)
cards.power:
Look Over There!
Move the Quest Die to a completely irrelevant Card on the Stage.

cards.art: adult man in diaper, crying in spotlight
cards.lore: When the path forward is blocked, the mind runs backward to the crib.
cards.name: REGRESSION (Regredieren)
cards.power:
Goo-Goo Ga-Ga.
Speak as your Actor, but with the vocabulary of a 3-year-old.

cards.art: top-hat showman painting over board game with patchwork
cards.lore: The lie we tell ourselves when we wake up, just to make the chaos look like a movie.
cards.name: SECONDARY REVISION (Sekundäre Bearbeitung)
cards.power:
The Retcon.
Change the ending of the previous player's story to make it "make sense".

cards.art: trash can with letters spilling out
cards.lore: The trash of yesterday becomes the treasure of tonight's hallucination.
cards.name: DAY RESIDUE (Tagesreste)
cards.power:
Boring Deja Vu.
You must incorporate a mundane object from the room you are currently in into the story.

cards.art: child kicking from beneath a chair
cards.lore: The oldest stuff lies deepest. You are still 4 years old and you want that cookie.
cards.name: INFANTILE MATERIAL (Das Infantile)
cards.power:
Tantrum.
Flip the Quest Die over to its opposite side (1 becomes 6).

cards.art: sleeper jolted by alarm and full bladder
cards.lore: The body is shouting, but the dream translates it into a symphony of pain.
cards.name: SOMATIC STIMULUS (Leibreiz)
cards.power: Wake Up Call. Slam the table. All players must drop their hands.

cards.art: screaming alarm clock face with teeth
cards.lore: The executioner of the dream. The return of the cruel, cold logic of 7:00 AM.
cards.name: THE ALARM CLOCK (Der Wecker)
cards.power: Kayfa-BOOM! End the current Quest immediately. No winner.

cards.art: top hat over phallic chess pawn
cards.lore: According to Freud, if it fits on a head, it stands in for the... other head.
cards.name: THE HAT (Der Hut)
cards.power:
Cover Up.
Place this card over an Actor. They are now "The Gentleman".

cards.art: hypnotic staircase descending
cards.lore: Up and down. In and out. The rhythm of the stairs is the rhythm of love. Allegedly.
cards.name: THE STAIRCASE (Die Treppe)
cards.power:
Rhythmic Motion.
Tap the table rhythmically while telling your story. If you stop, you lose your turn.

cards.art: drooping tie alone on hanger
cards.lore: It hangs down. It is useless. Men wear it. Do the math.
cards.name: THE TIE (Die Krawatte)
cards.power:
Symbolic Authority.
You are now the Boss. You decide who speaks next.

cards.art: tree shaped like mother silhouette
cards.lore: Mater comes from Mater (Mother). Wood is the universal mother-substitute. Don't ask.
cards.name: THE WOOD (Das Holz)
cards.power:
Maternal Origin.
Treat this card as a "Home Base". Players can retreat there to avoid logic.

cards.art: pliers yanking molar from screaming mouth
cards.lore: Losing a tooth in a dream isn't about dentists. It's about losing your... power.
cards.name: THE TOOTH EXTRACTOR (Zahnreiz)
cards.power:
Castration Anxiety.
The next player loses one card from their hand (randomly selected).

cards.art: steampunk rocket lifting off
cards.lore: Defying gravity. Rising up. The dream of flying is the dream of capability.
cards.name: THE FLYING MACHINE (Das Flugwerk)
cards.power:
Erection.
Rise up from your chair. You must play standing up until your next turn.

cards.art: tiny figure plummeting into void
cards.lore: Falling is giving in. Sometimes you want to hit the bottom.
cards.name: THE FALL (Der Sturz)
cards.power:
Surrender.
You may voluntarily discard your Actor to draw 2 new cards.

cards.art: cockroach in suit holding briefcase
cards.lore: Small animals represent small children. Usually the ones you wish weren't born.
cards.name: THE VERMIN (Das Ungeziefer)
cards.power:
Unwanted Sibling.
Choose another player. They are now your "Rival". You must contradict them.

cards.art: scowling king on throne crushing fun
cards.lore: The Father. The King. The Obstacle. He prohibits the fun.
cards.name: THE EMPEROR (Der Kaiser)
cards.power:
Dad's Law:
Veto any story element that challenges authority.

cards.art: queen offering glowing apple
cards.lore: The Mother. The Object. The Origin. The Forbidden Zone.
cards.name: THE QUEEN (Die Königin)
cards.power:
Mom's Favor:
Choose a player to protect. They cannot be challenged this round.

cards.art: cat burglar through window with sack
cards.lore: Every dream about a burglar is a dream about a distinct kind of 'entry'.
cards.name: THE INTRUDER (Der Eindringling)
cards.power:
Sexual Tension.
Introduce a romantic subplot between two cards that really shouldn't be together.

cards.art: two identical men pointing at each other
cards.lore: I'm not the bad guy. YOU are the bad guy who looks exactly like me.
cards.name: THE DOUBLE (Der Doppelgänger)
cards.power:
Projection.
Accuse another player of the strategy you are secretly using.

cards.art: naked student at unknown test
cards.lore: You've already passed this test years ago. Why are you back here? To prove you're a fraud.
cards.name: THE EXAMINATION (Der Prüfungstraum)
cards.power:
Performance Anxiety.
Ask the active player a trivia question. If they fail, their turn ends.

cards.art: nude man calmly walking among crowd
cards.lore: It's not about skin. It's about the childhood wish to show off, gone wrong.
cards.name: PUBLIC NAKEDNESS (Die Nacktheit)
cards.power:
Exposure.
Reveal your entire hand of cards to the table.

cards.art: man trying to run, legs rooted
cards.lore: You want to go, but your Will says 'No'. The conflict turns your legs to lead.
cards.name: THE PARALYSIS (Die Hemmung)
cards.power:
Stuck.
The Quest Die cannot be moved this turn, no matter the story.

cards.art: grandmother knitting in rocking chair, slightly translucent
cards.lore: If you dream they are dead, you secretly wished them dead. Don't look at me, Freud said it.
cards.name: THE DEAD RELATIVE (Der tote Verwandte)
cards.power:
Absurdity.
State a fact that is clearly false, but treat it as absolute truth.

cards.art: muscular figure gouging own eyes
cards.lore: The ultimate plot twist: You were the detective AND the murderer all along.
cards.name: OEDIPUS REX
cards.power:
Total Tragedy.
Destroy the current Stage. All scenes are discarded.

cards.art: sphinx with cigarette dangling
cards.lore: The gatekeeper of the story. Solve the riddle or get strangled by your own neurosis.
cards.name: THE SPHINX
cards.power:
The Riddle.
The active player must speak in a rhyme.

cards.art: burning chariot at desert crossroads
cards.lore: Where you met the Father. Where you struck him down. Where it all went wrong.
cards.name: THE CROSSROADS
cards.power:
Fate.
Force the story to take a tragic turn, regardless of logic.

cards.art: jester holding skull, frozen mid-thought
cards.lore: He couldn't kill the King because he *was* the King in his dream. Analysis paralysis.
cards.name: HAMLET (The Modern Oedipus)
cards.power:
Hesitation.
Skip your turn to think about doing something, but do nothing.

cards.art: dense web of arrows between symbols
cards.lore: Every dream image has ten different causes. It's a traffic jam of meaning.
cards.name: OVERDETERMINATION (Überdeterminierung)
cards.power:
Thick Plot.
Connect the current Story to at least 3 cards on the table.

cards.art: painter pointing at canvas labeled 'Constitutional Law'
cards.lore: Dreams can't think 'Because'. They have to show two things crashing into each other.
cards.name: REPRESENTABILITY (Darstellbarkeit)
cards.power:
Show, Don't Tell.
You cannot use abstract words (love, freedom, justice). Only objects.

cards.art: signs reading Left/No/Yes contradicting
cards.lore: In the unconscious, 'No' does not exist. Every 'No' is just a 'Yes' in a mask.
cards.name: OPPOSITES (Gegensinn)
cards.power:
Reverse Psychology.
Interpret the Quest Die's [1] as [6] and [6] as [1] for this turn.

cards.art: eye + saw + sheep equation
cards.lore: The dream is not a drawing. It is a puzzle text made of pictures. Read it, don't view it.
cards.name: THE REBUS (Der Bilderrätsel)
cards.power:
Decoding.
Guess the hidden motive of another player. If right, take their card.

cards.art: empty psychoanalyst's couch with rug
cards.lore: Lie down. Don't look at me. Just talk until you say something shameful.
cards.name: THE COUCH (Die Couch)
cards.power:
Free Association.
Say the first word that comes into your head. The next player must start their story with it.

cards.art: chairs piled against door
cards.lore: If you refuse to talk about it, that's exactly what we need to talk about.
cards.name: RESISTANCE (Widerstand)
cards.power:
Block.
Cancel the effect of the last card played.

cards.art: patient yelling at calm analyst
cards.lore: You aren't mad at me. You're mad at your Dad. But I'm charging you by the hour, so go ahead.
cards.name: TRANSFERENCE (Übertragung)
cards.power:
New Target.
Transfer the effect of a Power card to a different player.

cards.art: detective examining steaming poop with magnifier
cards.lore: The Royal Road to the Unconscious. Paved with bad intentions and dirty jokes.
cards.name: THE INTERPRETATION / DETECTIVE (Die Deutung)
cards.power:
Insight.
Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Arrange them how you like.

cards.art: yellow demonic face with neon teeth
cards.lore: I want. I take. I eat. I kill. I sex. NOW.
cards.name: THE ID (Es)
cards.power:
Primal Urge.
Ignore all rules for one turn. Just make something happen.

cards.art: man in suit juggling demons and angels
cards.lore: The poor clown trying to serve three masters at once. Reality, Id, and Super-Ego.
cards.name: THE EGO (Ich)
cards.power:
Compromise.
Move the Quest Die to the exact center [3.5] (or just say 3 or 4).

cards.art: looming Mosaic patriarch staring down
cards.lore: The internalized parent. It watches you shower. It judges your thoughts.
cards.name: THE SUPER-EGO (Über-Ich)
cards.power:
Guilt Trip.
Another player apologizes for their story. They lose a turn.

cards.art: red liquid pouring through funnel into glowing vessel
cards.lore: The fuel of the mind. It has to go somewhere. If you block it, it explodes.
cards.name: PSYCHIC ENERGY (Libido)
cards.power:
Cathexis.
Add +1 to the Resonance [R] of any card on the table.

cards.art: black hole burned into page
cards.lore: The best parts of the dream are the ones you can't remember. Trust me.
cards.name: THE GAP (Die Lücke)
cards.power:
Memory Hole.
Remove a Scene card from the Stage. It never happened.

cards.art: dark mushroom-navel descending into shadow
cards.lore: The spot where the dream reaches down into the unknown. Don't touch it.
cards.name: THE NAVEL (Der Nabel des Traums)
cards.power:
Unknowable.
This card cannot be removed or affected by any other card.

cards.art: dreamscape dissolving into mist as sun rises
cards.lore: The sun comes up and the truth evaporates. Back to your safe, boring life.
cards.name: MORNING AMNESIA (Das Vergessen)
cards.power:
Fade Out.
Shuffle the discard pile back into the deck.

cards.art: notepad with 'The Horse was a Toaster!!!' scrawl
cards.lore: Write it down fast, before the Censor wakes up and deletes the file.
cards.name: THE NOTEBOOK (Das Notizbuch)
cards.power:
Capture.
Keep the last played Quest card as a Trophy.

cards.art: two brains in jars connected by lightning
cards.lore: Freud hated this stuff, but he couldn't quite rule it out. Spooky.
cards.name: TELEPATHY (Telepathie)
cards.power:
Mind Read.
Look at another player's hand.

cards.art: identical black cat photographed twice in alley
cards.lore: I have been here before. Or maybe I just dreamed I was here. Whatever.
cards.name: DEJA VU
cards.power:
Repeat.
Play the same card you played last turn again.

cards.art: crystal ball with explosion inside
cards.lore: Is it the future? Or did you just wish for it so hard you made it happen?
cards.name: THE PROPHETIC DREAM (Wahrtraum)
cards.power:
Prediction.
Guess the number of the next die roll. If right, you win the Quest.

cards.art: caped flyer in pajamas with hammer
cards.lore: I know I am dreaming. Therefore, I am God. Now watch this backflip.
cards.name: LUCIDITY (Der Klartraum)
cards.power:
Control.
Change the rules of the game for one round. (e.g., "High rolls lose").

cards.art: rabbit reading dusty leatherbound 'Die Traumdeutung'
cards.name: HOW TO USE THIS DECK
cards.power: 1. Mix these with your Kayfabizarro Deck. 2. When you draw a Freud Card, things get weird. 3. Use "Freudian Logic" — if it makes no sense, it makes PERFECT sense. 4. Stay Fluffy.

cards.art: tongue with bowler hat slipping
cards.lore: The Unconscious has spoken!
cards.name: NEW RULE: THE SLIP
cards.power: If a player stumbles over a word, calls someone the wrong name, or giggles nervously: THEY MUST DRAW A CARD.

cards.art: cigar, train, key, padlock arranged neutrally
cards.name: NEW RULE: THE SYMBOL
cards.power: Whenever a Long Object or a Hollow Object is mentioned, all players must nod knowingly and say "Aha!" If you fail to nod, lose a turn.

cards.art: 'SIGGY 1900-Forever' headstone with dancing rabbit
cards.name: CREDITS & BLAME
cards.power: Based on the delirious ramblings of S. Freud (1900). Distorted by Uncle FrizzleBob. No liability accepted for sudden realizations of incestuous desires. KayfaBIZARRO!

title: Dream-Wrestling with Kayfabe-Freud: Where the Id Always Kicks Out at Two!
